reference: PROVISIONAL auto labels (rd_extract: error = unit_error+basis_error, non-error = correct)
bootstrap: percentile 95%, cluster resampling with replacement within each set; primary cluster = qid, secondary = drug

holm: p_holm_all over all 64 tests; p_holm_family within (comparison, set)
